WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT record_count
  FROM type_counts
  WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM type_counts)
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM type_counts)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;
